Class StripeTransactionPostProcessorTest

@IsTest
private class StripeTransactionPostProcessorTest

Test class for StripeTransactionPostProcessor. Validates the post-processor functionality for starting the orchestration after replication events, including configuration retrieval and async job enqueueing.
